question: Six friends A, B, C, I, J and K prepared together for an interview and each one scored differently. C didn't score less than K. J didn't score more than A. I scored less than 3 friends only. C scored more than A. B scored less than J but not the least. Who scored the least?
solution:
Given: Six friends A, B, C, I, J and K. 

1) I scored less than 3 friends only.

__ > __ > __ > I > __ > __

2) C scored more than A

3) J didn't score more than A.

C > A > J
